# Vox Programming Language — LLM / Agent Documentation Index
> Vox is a pre-1.0 (workspace 0.6.0) AI-native full-stack language that compiles to Rust and TypeScript.
> One .vox file can compile to a database schema, a type-safe server, and a browser UI.
> Install today by building from source. Release installers are not published.
> Maturity: compiler/CLI are the strongest surfaces.
> Current syntax: bare `table` / `query` / `mutation` / `server` / `tool` / `component`.
> Retired (hard parse errors): `@endpoint`, `@table type`, `@mcp.tool`. Do not emit them.
> Not the unrelated Vox-lang (English-to-assembly) project at github.com/Vox-lang/vox.
> All links listed in this index are verified against automated code tests.

## Agent Policy Entry Points
- [AGENTS.md](https://voxlang.org/agents/): Cross-tool policy for all coding agents (required reading)

## Language & Parser Specifications
- [Type System Reference](https://voxlang.org/reference/ref-type-system/): Verified type system specifications and primitives
- [Literals Reference](https://voxlang.org/reference/ref-literals/): Number, string, array, and object literal rules
- [Operator Precedence Reference](https://voxlang.org/reference/ref-operator-precedence/): Operator precedence and associativity tables
- [Parser Feature Matrix](https://voxlang.org/reference/parser-feature-matrix/): Implemented language syntax and grammar features
- [Parser Ambiguity Inventory](https://voxlang.org/reference/parser-ambiguity-inventory/): Grammar ambiguities and resolution rules

## Architecture & System SSOTs
- [Wire Format v1 SSOT](https://voxlang.org/architecture/wire-format-v1-ssot/): Network protocol wire format specification
- [Context Isolation SSOT](https://voxlang.org/architecture/context-isolation-ssot-2026/): Execution sandbox and context isolation guarantees
- [Frontend Surface Ownership](https://voxlang.org/reference/frontend-surface-ownership/): UI and GUI surface boundaries and ownership
- [ADR 021: Generated Workflow Durability Parity](https://voxlang.org/adr/021-generated-workflow-durability-parity/): Durable workflow journal and replay parity
- [ADR 025: Multi-Agent Lock Coherence](https://voxlang.org/adr/025-multi-agent-lock-coherence/): Lease propagation and concurrency semantics

## Contributor & Learning Guides
- [Contributor Hub](https://voxlang.org/contributors/contributor-hub/): Contributor entry point and documentation guide
- [Lesson 1 — Ownership in Practice](https://voxlang.org/learning/rust-via-vox/lesson-01-ownership-pattern-drill/): Ownership pattern drill for Vox and Rust
- [Clinical Export](https://voxlang.org/how-to/clinical-export-from-vox-apps/): Application-owned export and validation
- [Documentation Governance](https://voxlang.org/contributors/documentation-governance/): Doc authority map
- [Agent Instruction Architecture](https://voxlang.org/contributors/agent-instruction-architecture/): How AI agents should navigate this repo
- [How-to: wire AI assistants to vox_validate_source MCP](https://voxlang.org/how-to/how-to-mcp-vox-validate/): Configure Claude Desktop / Cursor to validate AI-generated Vox source against the real compiler with structured autofix suggestions; documents the diagnostic shape (`code` + `fixes`), the iterate-against-the-compiler loop, and the most useful diagnostic-code namespaces.
